steps.text: I found the failure mode: when an extension is absent in the temporary profile, its view registrations are removed and the in-memory custom-location map is cleared. Switching back restores the persisted container but never restores mappings for views that have not registered yet, so they later fall back to SCM. I’m adding the missing map refresh plus regression coverage.
